title: Cosmic Pink Vortex Selfie
description: A woman in a pink and black superhero-style outfit lies on stone steps taking a selfie with a spiked pink phone case while another woman in matching armor kneels beside her looking upward. Behind them looms a massive glowing pink and purple spiral galaxy vortex in a starry space sky, with a gothic cathedral covered in pink stripes and graffiti to the left.
prompt: A cinematic surreal scene of two women in matching pink and black armored superhero costumes in front of a massive glowing pink-purple spiral galaxy vortex swirling in a starry cosmos. One woman with long brown hair and a spiked headband lies on stone steps taking a selfie with a pink spiked phone, while the other with short black hair kneels beside her looking up in awe. A tall gothic cathedral with pink stripes and graffiti stands on the left side, dramatic lighting, vibrant colors, detailed digital painting.
